Vipul Misra Appointed Acting CEO of SriLankan Airlines

Vipul Misra has been appointed as the acting Chief Executive Officer of SriLankan Airlines. Misra previously held the position of head of engineering at the airline. He brings over two decades of experience in the aviation sector to the role, with a stated aim to enhance performance and sustainability.
